title: Cruel Summer

cues.en: Leave a dream high in the quiet of the night, you know that I caught it
cues.zh: 在寂靜的夜裡留下一個夢想，你知道我抓住了它
cues.text: Leave a dream high in the quiet of the night, you know that I caught it

cues.en: Bad bad boy, sunny toy with a price, you know that I bought it
cues.zh: 壞壞男孩，陽光明媚的玩具，有價格，你知道我買了它
cues.text: Bad bad boy, sunny toy with a price, you know that I bought it

cues.en: Kicking me slow out the window, I'm always waiting for you to be waiting below
cues.zh: 把我慢慢踢出窗外，我一直在等你在下面
cues.text: Kicking me slow out the window, I'm always waiting for you to be waiting below

cues.en: Devos roll the dice, angels roll their eyes, but doesn't kill me, makes me want you more
cues.zh: 德沃斯擲骰子，天使翻白眼，但不會殺死我，讓我更想要你
cues.text: Devos roll the dice, angels roll their eyes, but doesn't kill me, makes me want you more

cues.en: And it's new, the shape of your body is new, the feel that I've got any two
cues.zh: 而且它是新的，你的身體形狀是新的，我有任何兩個的感覺
cues.text: And it's new, the shape of your body is new, the feel that I've got any two

cues.en: The whole summer is good, that's what I tell in over
cues.zh: 整個夏天都很好，這就是我在結束時所說的
cues.text: The whole summer is good, that's what I tell in over

cues.en: We do not have the good, the walk to the full storm
cues.zh: 我們沒有好，走到全力風暴
cues.text: We do not have the good, the walk to the full storm

cues.en: We see that we'll just screw it up in these trying times when I try to get the headlights
cues.zh: 我們看到，當我試圖拿到車頭燈時，我們只會在這些艱難的時刻把事情搞砸
cues.text: We see that we'll just screw it up in these trying times when I try to get the headlights

cues.en: Summer's a knife, I'm always waiting for you just to come to the moon
cues.zh: 夏天就是一把刀，我一直在等你來到月亮上
cues.text: Summer's a knife, I'm always waiting for you just to come to the moon

cues.en: Brothers roll the dice, angels roll their eyes
cues.zh: 兄弟擲骰子，天使翻白眼
cues.text: Brothers roll the dice, angels roll their eyes

cues.en: And if I'm pleased, you'll be the last to know
cues.zh: 如果我高興的話，你將是最後一個知道的
cues.text: And if I'm pleased, you'll be the last to know

cues.en: Oh it's true, the shape of your body is blue
cues.zh: 噢，是的，你的身體形狀是藍色的
cues.text: Oh it's true, the shape of your body is blue

cues.en: The feeling I've got in it, ooh
cues.zh: 我在其中的感覺，哦
cues.text: The feeling I've got in it, ooh

cues.en: It's a cool summer, it's cold
cues.zh: 這是一個涼爽的夏天，天氣很冷
cues.text: It's a cool summer, it's cold

cues.en: That's what I tell no fools, and we go on heaven but
cues.zh: 這就是我不會對傻瓜說的話，我們會去天堂，但是
cues.text: That's what I tell no fools, and we go on heaven but

cues.en: It's a cool summer with you
cues.zh: 和你一起度過一個清涼的夏天
cues.text: It's a cool summer with you

cues.en: I'm drunk in the back of the car, and I'm cried like a baby coming home from the bar
cues.zh: 我在車後座喝醉了，從酒吧回家我哭得像個嬰兒
cues.text: I'm drunk in the back of the car, and I'm cried like a baby coming home from the bar

cues.en: I said I'm blind, but it wasn't true, I don't want to keep secrets just to keep you alive
cues.zh: 我說我瞎了，但那不是真的，我不想為了讓你活著而保守秘密
cues.text: I said I'm blind, but it wasn't true, I don't want to keep secrets just to keep you alive

cues.en: It's not getting through the garden gate, it's every night that's so much to seal my faith
cues.zh: 不是穿過花園的大門，而是每一個夜晚，這足以印證我的信仰
cues.text: It's not getting through the garden gate, it's every night that's so much to seal my faith

cues.en: I'll let my scream for whatever it's worth
cues.zh: 我會為了任何值得的事情而尖叫
cues.text: I'll let my scream for whatever it's worth

cues.en: I'll love you, ain't that the worst thing to ever want?
cues.zh: 我會愛你，這不是最糟糕的事嗎？
cues.text: I'll love you, ain't that the worst thing to ever want?

cues.en: It's a cool summer, it's a cool summer with you
cues.zh: 涼爽的夏天，有你的夏天，涼爽的夏天
cues.text: It's a cool summer, it's a cool summer with you

cues.text: I'm drunk in the back of the car, and I'm cried like a baby coming home from the bar

cues.en: I said I'm blind, but it wasn't true, I don't want to keep secrets just to keep you alive
cues.zh: 我說我瞎了，但那不是真的，我不想為了讓你活著而保守秘密
cues.text: I said I'm blind, but it wasn't true, I don't want to keep secrets just to keep you alive

cues.en: It's not getting through the garden gate, it's every night that's so much to seal my faith
cues.zh: 不是穿過花園的大門，而是每一個夜晚，這足以印證我的信仰
cues.text: It's not getting through the garden gate, it's every night that's so much to seal my faith

cues.en: I scream for whatever it's worth, I'll love you, ain't that the worst thing to ever want?
cues.zh: 我尖叫著，無論付出什麼代價，我都會愛你，這不是最糟糕的事嗎？
cues.text: I scream for whatever it's worth, I'll love you, ain't that the worst thing to ever want?

cues.en: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
cues.zh: 是啊是啊是啊
cues.text: Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah
